about.title: About
about.lede: Tune Out is a small, non-commercial, open-source community project. It makes the world's internet radio stations easy to browse, search, and share — and publishes that catalog as fully open data.
about.data.title: Where the data comes from
about.data.body: Station metadata comes from the community at radio-browser.info, whose records are in the public domain.
about.license.title: License
about.license.body: Code and data are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 — the most permissive Creative Commons option.
about.privacy.title: Privacy
about.privacy.body: No accounts, no tracking. Recents, favorites, and collections live in your browser. Album-art lookups query Apple's public iTunes Search API with only the song title — no identifiers are sent.
about.contributing.title: Contributing translations
about.contributing.body: Every station page has an "Edit on GitHub" link. Add per-language description, summary, or keywords in the YAML's `localized:` block — your translation goes live on the next build.

locale.label: Language
faq.title: Help & FAQ
faq.lede: How the catalog works, how to add new languages, and how to help out.
faq.current_languages.title: Languages we currently support
faq.current_languages.body: Each language ships a UI translation file plus optional per-station name, description, summary, and keyword overrides in the source YAML.
faq.add_language.title: Adding a new language
faq.add_language.body: Adding a new locale is mostly translation work — no code is required for ~95% of the change. The contributor flow we'd like to support looks like this:
faq.add_language.step1: Open an issue on GitHub proposing the language. Include the BCP-47 code (e.g., de, es) and whether it's left-to-right or right-to-left.
faq.add_language.step2: Copy src/spa/i18n/strings/en.json to src/spa/i18n/strings/<code>.json and translate every value. Keep the keys exactly as they are.
faq.add_language.step3: Optionally add a localized tag dictionary at src/spa/i18n/tags/<code>.json mapping the popular tags (rock, jazz, …) to their native forms.
faq.add_language.step4: Open a pull request. We'll add the locale to SUPPORTED_LOCALES, the SQLite column triple (name_<code>, desc_<code>, kw_<code>), and the build pipeline picks it up automatically.
faq.add_language.tbd: Detailed contributor guide TBD — drop a comment on GitHub if you'd like to drive a language and we'll make sure the path is unblocked.
faq.station_text.title: Localizing individual stations
faq.station_text.body: Every station's YAML file accepts an optional localized: block keyed by language code. Per locale, you can override the station name and supply a description, a one-line summary, and extra search keywords. Anything you leave out falls back to the canonical English data.
faq.contact.title: Where to ask
faq.contact.body: Issues and proposals live on GitHub at {repo}. The repository's README has the maintainer roster.
